Added: Structured Unity content fields for seven tables, nested effects, tag lists and campaign settings.
Search, readable duplicate IDs, explicit reward enrollment and Unity Undo/Redo.
Recoverable draft checkpoints, stale-source detection and atomic saves with exact-byte backups.
Read-only Android device preflight reports real connected hardware and keeps physical gameplay status separate.
Changed: Editor saves, CSV imports and build imports share referenced-sprite validation, including equipment art.
The owner guide explains editing, recovery, backups and adding new content. Gameplay, balance and campaign save schema are unchanged.

Import failures after a successful save report that the source was already saved and backed up.
KnownIssues: Physical Android/iOS play and graphical Windows play remain unverified; no Android device is connected.

The adaptation does not include every original mechanic or content item.
Two inherited browser CI inventory failures remain documented and waived for this work.
Unity compilation uses the local licensed Editor; packaged-build validation and dev Pages publication are automated.
Draft checkpoints run explicitly and on window close/recompile; they are not continuous crash-proof autosave.
WhatToTest: Open AshenSpire > Campaign Content Editor, duplicate a card and expand its Effects list. Change an amount, then use Undo and Redo.
Search another table and return to confirm draft edits remain. Use Add this card to reward catalog when it should become a reward.
Checkpoint an unsaved draft, close and reopen the window, and verify recovery.
Use Save & Import, restart Play mode and test the modified card.
Play or resume a campaign and compare movement, preferences and saved progress with the previous build.
